assessment_details.rationale: O has no matched CPO tied-parameter protected-coordinate regularizer path or ZeRO-3 owner-only gradient/logging correction.

O optimizes information value and preserves source-bound evidence, but has no matched predictable adaptive-importance-sampling proof that retains all pilot and production observations with exact unbiasedness.
O reasons about expected elapsed time and marginal work value, but has no matched reuse-versus-discard variance threshold derived for a predictable adaptive-importance-sampling estimator.

O preserves scoped negative evidence and revises decisions when assumptions change, but has no matched result showing a discarded-pilot negative flips under exact unbiased pilot reuse while tail safety remains unresolved.
O uses held-out/protected evaluation, but has no matched 20,000-replicate rare-event adaptive-IS validation comparing original-proposal-weighted pilot reuse with discard.
O has frozen request identity and no-repeat recovery discipline, but no matched evaluation-generation rule that an ambiguously launched observation invalidates the generation.
O forbids repeating external effects after restart, but has no matched measurement-validity rule that a possibly launched fresh-process observation index must never be retried.
O tracks invocation/request identities and fresh evaluation boundaries, but has no matched job-independent worker-lifetime process-epoch identity requirement for sharded capture.
O binds context/source provenance and controls external research intake, but has no matched trajectory-coordinated search-intermediary poisoning benchmark or red-team controller.
O uses durable receipts, replayable state and completion claim boundaries, but has no matched typed claim-to-trace Evidence-Carrying Termination certificate with deterministic replay.
O rechecks effects and isolates execution state, but has no matched fixed-trace experiment separating delayed outcome finality from cross-unit shared-state contamination.
O has manifest-bound effect authorization and critical-source rechecks, but no matched non-upgradable action-induction provenance plus argument-level support gate across later history.

O treats supplied context as non-authoritative hypotheses and rechecks effects, but has no matched study where evidence packaging changes action commitment while stated belief/knowability stays stable.
O has held-out evaluation and contamination controls, but no matched subtype-resolved eval-awareness framing analysis showing aggregate suppression can hide opposite compliance effects.

O already has effect receipts, postcondition checks and completion/continuity guards, but no matched TraceGrant Effect-Receipt versus Final-Answer-Gate ablation including authority-binding completeness failures.
O has effect/postcondition verification, but no matched contract-component ladder over deterministic refund cases separating status, entity binding, amount, duplicate semantics and finality.
O distinguishes internal success from externally valid evidence and tracks effect integrity, but has no matched private-oracle commit-valid-success benchmark ladder like CAV-Bench.
O has idempotency records and effect identities, but no matched provider-specific retention/scope/fingerprint certification plus mandatory live effect proof before terminal forward progress.
O supports reversible Candidates and rollback, but has no matched external-effect compensation DAG requiring known-live state, reverse topological order and verified compensation outcomes.
O has recovery routing and fail-closed continuation, but no matched controller that chooses certified forward reconciliation versus verified rollback across explicit points of no return.
O has no matched CAUSE Gaussian-state-space volatility/stochasticity formula reimplementation or source-known bandit control.
O has no matched active source-identification controller for volatility/stochasticity with diagnostic pulls and Bayesian model averaging comparison.
O has no matched PF-HMM-style discrete volatility/stochasticity source inference for binary outcomes.
O uses fences/CAS and durable state but not this local locking stack; it has no matched Portalocker 4.2 Windows raw-descriptor dependency-floor analysis.
O uses leases/fences/CAS and durable effect state, but has no matched Argus cross-platform event-authority contract using Portalocker 4.2+ raw-descriptor locking.
O fails closed on malformed durable records, but has no matched byte-safe torn-UTF-8 tail isolation rule that preserves damaged bytes while allowing later valid physical rows.
O represents unknown/contradictory evidence explicitly, but has no matched stable-generation byte reader with FOUND/ABSENT/UNKNOWN semantics under target-relevant JSONL corruption.
O has replay/provenance validation and adaptive compute, but no matched preregistered coalition probe97/gap47 confirmation with exact ROBDD oracle checks.
O tracks method-family heterogeneity, but has no matched per-family result showing the only missed positive arrives extremely late and fixed shallow probes transfer unevenly.
O requires scoped comparative evidence, but has no matched component-attribution correction showing a composite policy can pass while its probe component contributes zero gain.
O retains protected incumbents and expected-time optimization, but has no matched paired confirmation where direct gap65 threshold recovers all gain at about 21.6% tail compute.
O supports optional work under protected baselines, but has no matched preregistered result where uniform +32 probing adds 8.91% compute for zero incremental gain.
O can reject saturated methods, but has no matched scope-limited conclusion that future probes must justify marginal value specifically on direct-reject states.
O has protected Candidate/promotion gates, but no matched material-science capability-gate ablation with the corrected 3/15 to 5/15 phonon-workflow attempt result and eliminated false-refusal class.

O is structurally close to Gauntlet through isolated Candidates, frozen evaluation, durable events and write-ahead effects, but lacks the exact inspected fixed-look promotion implementation, online error control and fourth terminal OUTER lockbox.

O has durable evidence and Candidate promotion machinery, but no matched prompt-evolver contrast where mutable promotion counters remain authoritative despite an append-only evidence spine elsewhere in the same architecture.
